OPTIONAL RULE UPDATE: When the victim of a poison-like effect (CP:R, pg. 181) succeeds at the corresponding Resist Torture/Drugs Check to not suffer the poison’s damage, the afflicting poison deals half damage (Roll first, then halve) instead of dealing no damage to the victim.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) per dose

Though developed after the 4th Corporate War for diver protection against biotech-modified deep sea wildlife, this Neurotoxin was never made in much quantity due to limited supplies needed for its chemical components. Yet, as the decades have gone by, modified strains of this formula have enabled much easier production and brought it to the attention of many corporate assassins. A single dose can cause near-instant muscle decay and intense pain as the neurotoxin’s caustic elements latch onto a target’s nervous system.

Poison. An entire vial of Neurotoxin can be smeared on any Light Melee Weapon as an Action. For the next minute (20 Rounds) after application, instead of dealing the weapon’s typical damage, anyone meat hit by the Neurotoxin-coated Light Melee Weapon must instead attempt to beat a DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs Check. Anyone who fails is dealt 3d6 damage directly to their HP, which does not interact with or ablate any of their SP.

When rolling for damage with Neurotoxin, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of determining the incurring of Critical Injuries (Which Neurotoxin can still inflict, with the exception of any Dismemberment Critical Injuries, for which it deals the Bonus Damage of but does not inflict the effect of). Critical Injuries caused by Neurotoxin can be Head Critical Injuries as long as the initial Attack was an Aimed Shot to the victim’s head.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Poisons).
